pr_body:
Fix https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/issues/9672

This fixes markdown anchor links by prepending `#user-content` to it.

If this is not the fix you are looking or if you need tests feel free to create your own pull request.
Unfortunately I don't have the time to do that.

issue_context.title: Markdown anchor links don't work
issue_context.body:
- Gitea version (or commit ref): a311ace354c4a00e0576943b0b0bff651fbcb066 ([master](https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/tree/master))
- Git version: 2.24.1
- Operating system: Arch Linux
- Database: SQLite
- Can you reproduce the bug at https://try.gitea.io:
  - Yes, https://try.gitea.io/adfjiowfeiofhaehioh/test-markdown/src/branch/master/test.md

## Description

Anchor links (to headers) in markdown link to `#anchor` instead of `#user-content-anchor` (modified).
See the [provided link](https://try.gitea.io/adfjiowfeiofhaehioh/test-markdown/src/branch/master/test.md).

review_comments: The `if` can be rearranged with the code above so the conditions are only checked once (e.g. `len(link)>0` and `link[0]=='#'`)
I don't know if this is more readable so I would like some other opinions whether this is worth it.

@guillep2k the first `if` has `link[0] != '#'` and the second has `link[0] == '#'` (note: the `!` in the first that isn't in second), so I think that even though there is one conditional in the `if` that overlaps, any computation time that would be saved is minimal, and potentially even make the whole section of code be less readable (but that is from my rough attempts to combine them which I haven't spent too much time trying, I'd be happy to be proven wrong).
